record_pooled_legacy.caveat: duplicate-weighted pooled rows; retained as diagnostic

unique_model_unscaled.caveat: grid-cell profiles without cluster structural matching

structurally_rescaled.caveat: each unique CMC realization rescaled to each cluster's observed (M, Rc); SEM is the spread of the per-realization ensemble means

observed_residual.description: Bootstrap uncertainty on the controlled residual

cmc_model_realization.description: SEM of the per-realization ensemble means across the unique CMC grid models (rescaled analysis)

cluster_structural.source: Harris catalog ±0.2 dex central density scatter

intrinsic_spindown.description: Intrinsic Pdot scatter of field MSP reference
intrinsic_spindown.source: Field MSP log|Pdot| std ~0.3 dex; mean uncertainty ~0.08

ensemble_propagated_stack.description: 20-cluster ensemble propagation scaling uncorrelated per-cluster structural (±0.20/sqrt(20) dex plus ±0.06 dex coherent zero-point) and intrinsic spin-down (±0.08/sqrt(20) dex) terms by 1/sqrt(N_cl) and using the measured 1rc-5rc core radial-filter std from step_38.

notes: Nominal 13.2 sigma uses only the observed bootstrap uncertainty and is a diagnostic, not the claim.
Model-aware 13.0 sigma adds the measured realization-to-realization SEM of the CMC ensemble.
Conservative stack 4.1 sigma adds structural, period-distribution, radial-filter and intrinsic spin-down terms in quadrature.
The 20 cluster selections map to a small number of unique CMC realizations; duplicated realizations are not independent draws.
